'''Eckart Viehweg''' (born 30 December 1948 in [[Zwickau]], died 29 January 2010)<ref name="Welcome to commalg.org! 2010">{{cite web | title=Eckart Viehweg, 1948–2010 | website=Welcome to commalg.org! | date=3 February 2010 | url=https://www.commalg.org/2010/02/03/eckart-viehweg-1948-2010/ | access-date=16 December 2021}}</ref> was a German mathematician. He was a professor of [[algebraic geometry]] at the [[University of Duisburg-Essen]].

In 2003 he won the [[Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize]] with his wife, [[Hélène Esnault]].
